mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS implementation, chosen because its implementation is cleaner than the approach used before it. This decision has not been superseded by any later recorded decision.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says the current recorded decision is rustls as the TLS implementation, chosen because it is cleaner than the previous approach. It also says no later decision supersedes it.

The only source is claude-mem observation #4, "Switched to rustls for TLS implementation". The later observations (#13–#16) are about certificate verification and HTTPS enforcement, not the backend, so I left them out. The repo itself records no TLS backend decision.

The recorded decision names rustls, which is a Rust library, but this repository is Go (gin) and uses the standard `crypto/tls`. I wrote the recorded decision as it stands and did not reconcile it with the code. You may want to check that observation.

My first attempt to write the file with a shell heredoc failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool instead. The file exists and is correct.
